title: Project 2 - Static EDA
text:
Data Setup
Import downloaded raw CSV data.
Convert to R-friendly variable names using the janitor package, and force data to classic tibble structure (instead of spc_tbl_ )

mxmh_raw <- read_csv("data/mxmh_survey_results.csv")

Rows: 736 Columns: 33
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr (26): Timestamp, Primary streaming service, While working, Instrumentali...
dbl  (7): Age, Hours per day, BPM, Anxiety, Depression, Insomnia, OCD

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.

mxmh_raw <- janitor::clean_names(as_tibble(mxmh_raw))
